title: Layout-flow benchmark corpus exclusions (klt.design_agent_benchmark.layout_exclusions/1)
description: Candidates considered for the layout corpus (#3025) and rejected. A candidate failing any protocol `task_eligibility` rule is excluded from all three arms and recorded here with a machine-readable reason -- never silently scored on fewer arms. `reason` is the closed set of protocol rule ids, so there is one eligibility vocabulary across tasks and exclusions.

recipe.description: For `generator_reachable` exclusions: the recipe that fails to reach a valid layout. The corpus gate re-runs it and requires it to still fail, so the exclusion cannot go stale silently.
